split_rationale: H3 is a longitudinal phenotyping question. It cannot be rescued by changing random seeds, cluster counts, thresholds, or exclusions after a stability failure; any new design needs a separately reviewed protocol before execution.

evidence_groups.pre_review_conclusion: Supports evaluating stability when choosing and validating a clustering solution; it does not justify post-hoc reseeding or outcome-guided selection.
Provides a representative ICU trajectory-phenotyping example, not a transferable cluster count, feature set, or clinical conclusion.
Low cross-center agreement supports treating a stable MIMIC-IV solution as local discovery only until the identical protocol reproduces externally.

required_signoff: The v1 diagonal-GMM k=6 protocol with mean ARI 0.5357 below 0.70 remains terminal; no seed, k, threshold, feature, imputation, or exclusion change can rescue it.

The v3 population and representation are fixed before execution: MIMIC-IV ICU stays with at least two owner-available SOFA-2 windows, ICU admission anchor, hours 0-72, 12-hour maximum grid, six SOFA-2 components plus lactate as clustering coordinates, and SOFA-2 total as descriptive/audit only.

SOFA-2 concept-owner missingness semantics are retained: direct observations and owner-authorized LOCF values are distinguished and audited, owner-unavailable values are excluded, and no additional clustering-stage imputation is permitted.

Coordinates use pooled observed-value z-scores with ddof=0; centers, scales, counts, mask policy, and the scaling digest must be emitted by the deterministic stability executor, and any zero-variance coordinate fails closed.

The model family is observed-data diagonal Gaussian mixture, candidate k is 2-6, and minimum BIC selects without outcomes. If the minimum BIC is at k=6, execution returns H3_NO_INTERIOR_BIC_OPTIMUM rather than claiming an identified optimum or expanding k post hoc; a selected cluster below 5% yields no stable solution without trying another k.

Stability uses exactly 100 80%-subsample refits from base seed 1729 and requires all 100 to succeed. Numerical/refit failure is an engine failure, while a completed mean ARI below 0.70 is scientific instability and the formal no-stable-phenotype result.
Outcome comparisons occur only after frozen assignment and remain descriptive; MIMIC-IV discovery is not transportable without external reproduction under the identical protocol.
